page.title: Abahuza
page.intro: Huza konti zawe zo kwamamaza. Ubuyobozi buvuye kumatangazo yawe bugera mubuyobozi bwanjye mu buryo bwikora, hamwe nogukoresha hamwe nigiciro kuri buri kuyobora.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form kuyobora, gukoresha buri munsi nigiciro kuri buri cyerekezo, hamwe nubuyobozi bwiza bwoherejwe kuri LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).

banner.connected: LinkedIn ihuza. Ubuyobozi burimo kuzanwa nonaha - iyi page ivugurura mukanya.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn ntabwo yashyizweho kuriyi seriveri. Umuyobozi agomba kongeramo ID ya porogaramu ya LinkedIn n'ibanga.
banner.expired: Ihuza LinkedIn ryararangiye, kuyobora rero ntabwo bihuza. Ongera uhuze kugirango ukomeze.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn igusaba kongera kwinjira na {{date}} . Ongera uhuze mbere hanyuma kugirango ukomeze kuyobora.

connect.title: Huza LinkedIn
connect.intro: Injira hamwe na konte LinkedIn icunga amatangazo yawe. Leadrat isoma gusa konte yawe yamamaza, Lead Gen Form iyobora hamwe na statistique yamamaza, kandi ikohereza impinduka ukinguye.
connect.need1: Uruhare kuri konte yamamaza LinkedIn (Reba cyangwa hejuru).
connect.need2: Uruhare kurupapuro rwisosiyete ihujwe (Umuyobozi, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Ushinzwe gukurikirana cyangwa Ushinzwe gusesengura) - LinkedIn isaba gusangira kuyobora.
connect.need3: Ikibazo cya nimero ya terefone Lead Gen Forms - kiyobora nta numero ya terefone ntishobora kongerwaho.

connection.title: Kwihuza
connection.autoRenews: Kwinjira bishya mu buryo bwikora kugeza icyo gihe
connection.syncResult: Sync yakozwe: {{received}} yakiriwe, {{created}} yaremye, {{duplicates}} kwigana, {{rejected}} yanze.
connection.confirmDisconnect: Guhagarika LinkedIn ? Guhuza birahagarara kandi ibimenyetso byinjira byasibwe. Kuyobora, imibare na logi y'ibikorwa irabikwa.
connection.noPermission: Urashobora kureba iyi page. Guhuza no guhindura igenamiterere rikeneye uruhushya "Gucunga Igenamiterere".
connection.fetchHint: Ubuyobozi bushya bugenzurwa buri minota mike kandi iminsi 7 yanyuma irongera igenzurwa burimunsi, ntakintu rero kibuze. Koresha ibi kubiyobora kuva mbere uhuza, cyangwa kugirango ugenzure ikindi gihe (kugeza iminsi 90 icyarimwe). Imiyoborere isanzwe muri Leadrat irasimbuka.

accounts.title: Konti yamamaza
accounts.intro: Kuyobora no kubara bihujwe kuva kuri konti yamamaza yafunguye hano.
accounts.none: Nta konte yamamaza yabonetse kuriyi konte LinkedIn . Reba uruhare rwa konte muri LinkedIn Campaign Manager , hanyuma usubize.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Bwira LinkedIn niyihe iyobora yabaye ibyiringiro nyabyo. Iyo umurongo LinkedIn ugeze kumurongo wahisemo hepfo, Leadrat abimenyesha LinkedIn , raporo zawe zo kwiyamamaza rero zerekana ubuziranenge kandi LinkedIn irashobora kubona abantu benshi nkuyobora neza. Gusa LinkedIn iyobora ID hamwe ninzira imwe hash ya imeri yoherejwe.
capi.created: Guhindura byakozwe kuri LinkedIn kandi byashushanyije.

activity.title: Igitabo cyibikorwa
activity.intro: Ibintu byose hagati ya Leadrat na LinkedIn : guhuza, buri sync, buri kuyobora hamwe nibyabaye, guhinduka namakosa.
